extractions.value: Patient initially presented with compartment syndrome requiring fasciotomy, which authors hypothesize was caused by recurrent SPS-related muscle stiffness and spasms. Limited abduction of extraocular movement was noted but without diplopia, and vertical eye movements were intact.
extractions.quote: This is the first case report of SPS possibly presenting initially with compartment syndrome.
